Woodlore imparts [[adventurers]] who practise it with the expertise of laying traps, summoning animal [[:Category:Class Loyals|guardians]], and performing a variety of other [[combat]]-related, [[forestal]] [[:Category:Abilities|abilities]].

The skill was first taught to members of the [[Sentinels of Nature|Sentinels Guild]] by [[Vixen]] after she had in turn learned the art from [[Etarni]] during her extended stay in the [[:Category:Villages|village]] of the [[Tomacula]], following the Sentinels' act of annihilating their [[Groves]] to cure Vixen of a feverish ailment that had befallen her.

The skill of '''Woodlore''' is available to members of the [[Sentinel]] [[class]], along with [[Metamorphosis]] and [[Skirmishing]].

{{Skill_detail

{{Skill_detail

This does not consume balance or equilibrium, and the animal does not need to be actively summoned for you to call it forth for a single attack. <p>'''Badger''': will deliver bleeding and addiction. If the target already has addiction, will deliver nausea.</p><p>'''Fox''': will deliver healthleech.</p><p>'''Wolf''': will give hallucinations.</p><p>'''Lemming''': will strip rebounding or shield; if neither are present, it will strip a random defence.
